query:
UPDATE "campaigns"
            SET
                title = COALESCE($1, title),
                description = COALESCE($2, description),
                opening_date_time = COALESCE($3, opening_date_time),
                closing_date_time = COALESCE($4, closing_date_time),
                allow_role_overlaps = COALESCE($5, allow_role_overlaps)
            WHERE campaign_id = $6
